lines.gurmukhi: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਤੈ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਮੂ ਦਸਿ ਦਸੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: yaar ve tai raaviaa laalan moo das dasa(n)daa ||
lines.translation: O intimate friend, you have enjoyed your Beloved; please, tell me about Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਨੁ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਜੈ ਧਨ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: laalan tai paaiaa aap gavaaiaa jai dhan bhaag mathaane ||
lines.translation: They alone find their Beloved, who eradicate self-conceit; such is the good destiny written on their foreheads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਂਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਹਉ ਘਿਧੀ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baa(n)h pakaR thaakur hau ghidhee gun avagan na pachhaane ||
lines.translation: Taking me by the arm, the Lord and Master has made me His own; He has not considered my merits or demerits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਹਾਰੁ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਭੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun haar tai paaiaa ra(n)g laal banaaiaa tis habho kichh suha(n)daa ||
lines.translation: She, whom You have adorned with the necklace of virtue, and dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love - everything looks beautiful on her.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਵਸੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak dha(n)n suhaagan saaee jis sa(n)g bhataar vasa(n)daa ||3||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, blessed is that happy soul-bride, who dwells with her Husband Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਖੇਦੀ ਸਾ ਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: yaar ve nit sukh sukhedee saa mai paaee ||
lines.translation: O intimate friend, I have found that peace which I sought.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਰੁ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: var loReedaa aaiaa vajee vaadhaaee ||
lines.translation: My sought-after Husband Lord has come home, and now, congratulations are pouring in.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਥੀਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦ ਨਵ ਰੰਗੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa ma(n)gal rahas theeaa pir daiaal sad nav ra(n)geeaa ||
lines.translation: Great joy and happiness welled up, when my Husband Lord, of ever-fresh beauty, showed mercy to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸਤਸੰਗੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: vad bhaag paaiaa gur milaaiaa saadh kai satasa(n)geeaa ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, I have found Him; the Guru has united me with Him, through the Saadh Sangat, the True Congregation of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਪੂਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਅੰਕਿ ਅੰਕੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa manasaa sagal pooree pri a(n)k a(n)k milaaee ||
lines.translation: My hopes and desires have all been fulfilled; my Beloved Husband Lord has hugged me close in His embrace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਖੇਦੀ ਸਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sukh sukhedee saa mai gur mil paaee ||4||1||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I have found that peace which I sought, meeting with the Guru. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਛੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 2 chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਕਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: oochaa agam apaar prabh kathan na jaai akath ||
lines.translation: God is lofty, unapproachable and infinite. He is indescribable - He cannot be described.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee raakhan kau samarath ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, who is all-powerful to save us. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jaanahu tiu raakh har prabh teriaa ||
lines.translation: Save me, any way You can; O Lord God, I am Yours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੇ ਗਨਉ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੇਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kete ganau asa(n)kh avagan meriaa ||
lines.translation: My demerits are uncountable; how many of them should I count?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਅਵਗਣ ਖਤੇ ਫੇਰੇ ਨਿਤਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਸਦ ਭੂਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: asa(n)kh avagan khate phere nitaprat sad bhooleeai ||
lines.translation: The sins and crimes I committed are countless; day by day, I continually make mistakes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਘੂਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: moh magan bikaraal maaiaa tau prasaadee ghooleeai ||
lines.translation: I am intoxicated by emotional attachment to Maya, the treacherous one; by Your Grace alone can I be saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੂਕ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨੇਰ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: look karat bikaar bikhaRe prabh ner hoo te neriaa ||
lines.translation: Secretly, I commit hideous sins of corruption, even though God is the nearest of the near.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਭਵਜਲ ਫੇਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak daiaa dhaarahu kaadh bhavajal pheriaa ||1||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord, and lift me up, out of the whirlpool of the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਅਸੰਖ ਗੁਣ ਊਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nirat na pavai asa(n)kh gun oochaa prabh kaa naau ||
lines.translation: Countless are His virtues; they cannot be enumerated. God's Name is lofty and exalted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)teeaa milai nithaave thaau ||2||
lines.translation: This is Nanak's humble prayer, to bless the homeless with a home. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ਕਾ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: doosar naahee thaau kaa pahi jaaeeai ||
lines.translation: There is no other place at all - where else should I go?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar kar joR so prabh dhiaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, with my palms pressed together, I meditate on God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhiaai so prabh sadaa apunaa manahi chi(n)diaa paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Meditating forever on my God, I receive the fruits of my mind's desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj maan mohu vikaar doojaa ek siu liv laaeeai ||
lines.translation: Renouncing pride, attachment, corruption and duality, I lovingly center my attention on the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਰਪਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਗੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: arap man tan prabhoo aagai aap sagal mitaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Dedicate your mind and body to God; eradicate all your self-conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa saach naam samaaeeai ||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your mercy, Lord, that I may be absorbed in Your True Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man taa kau dhiaaeeai sabh bidh jaa kai haath ||
lines.translation: O mind, meditate on the One, who holds everything in His hands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam dhan sa(n)cheeai naanak nibahai saath ||3||
lines.translation: Gather the wealth of the Lord's Name; O Nanak, it shall always be with You. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਥੀਅੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saatheeaRaa prabh ek doosar naahi koi ||
lines.translation: God is our only True Friend; there is not any other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar aap jal thal poor soi ||
lines.translation: In the places and interspaces, in the water and on the land, He Himself is pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal poor rahiaa sarab daataa prabh dhanee ||
lines.translation: He is totally permeating the water, the land and the sky; God is the Great Giver, the Lord and Master of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gopaal gobi(n)d a(n)t naahee bea(n)t gun taa ke kiaa ganee ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the world, the Lord of the universe has no limit; His Glorious Virtues are unlimited - how can I count them?

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਅਨ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaj saran suaamee sukhah gaamee tis binaa an naahi koi ||
lines.translation: I have hurried to the Sanctuary of the Lord Master, the Bringer of peace; without Him, there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak daiaa dhaarahu tis paraapat naam hoi ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, that being, unto whom the Lord shows mercy - he alone obtains the Naam. ||3||
